## Description

Brief summary of the changes introduced in this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `test`: New or modified tests
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD or build workflow update
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance or tooling task

## Verification & Testing

- [ ] `pnpm lint` passed with 0 errors
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passed with 0 errors
- [ ] `pnpm test` unit and integration tests passed
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` Playwright acceptance tests passed
- [ ] `pnpm build` Next.js & NestJS builds compiled cleanly

## Changeset Included

- [ ] Changeset added via `pnpm changeset` or `pnpm changeset:auto` (required for versioned packages)
